title: Valve for a vacuum handling or clamping device, and vacuum handling device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: Each suction element 18 delimits a suction space 20 which is open in the suction direction, and which rests against a workpiece 16 forming a tight seal for suctioning said workpiece.
features.note: The reference discloses a suction element that forms a tight seal for suctioning a workpiece, but it does not explicitly mention a carrier plate.
